summary: PASS for P19B-C's own scope with two disclosed residuals. All three acceptance criteria are now machine-verified: the six canonical keys render in one pinned order on desktop, remote and TUI (proven cross-surface by the shared renderer and the overlay row-order pins), the decision is forwarded rather than re-minted so the daemon remains the only minting path, and revocation reads as future-runs-only everywhere -- the desktop superseded row was the one real gap and is fixed. QA also pinned a genuine fail-open in this task's own code: EffectAuthority::from_list_row accepted any string for state while is_active() is a two-state test, so an unknown state rendered as 已撤销 and masqueraded as a revocation the daemon never recorded, even though the remote and desktop already reject that set; from_list_row now refuses anything outside active|superseded. verify-remote.mjs registration was required because run-tests.mjs only discovers scripts/*.test.mjs, so the task-mandated src/remote/core path would otherwise have been dead coverage. Disclosed residuals, neither introduced by P19B-C: (1) Canvas.tsx sits over the 2600 quality limit as measured pre-existing debt and needs its own split task; (2) r-code-tui and r-code-host carry pre-existing red (no-provider plan-region timeouts, the deferred t35 set_preferences decision, and a full-crate TUI number that leaked-daemon file locks make unmeasurable), which the loop has never counted because those two crates were outside every prior denominator.
